Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks for the quick intro, Sam. I’d love to get a 60-minute discovery + demo scheduled so we can understand CloudForge’s latency/cost targets and walk through the security/ops checklist early. Proposed attendees:
- Alex Martinez (AE, Redwood)
- Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineer, Redwood)
- Tessa Morgan (Customer Success / AM, Redwood)
- Sam Bishop (Product Champion, CloudForge)
- Priya Ramanathan (Engineering Lead, CloudForge)
- Jenna Lee (Procurement, CloudForge)

Two initial windows that work for the Redwood team (PT):
1) Mon Mar 20 — 09:00–10:00 PT
2) Tue Mar 21 — 13:00–14:00 PT

If neither works, send two slots that do. Also attaching a short pre-demo questionnaire to help Rishi focus the technical portion (network/firewall, model/data residency needs, and success criteria). If procurement needs a preliminary pricing ballpark to triage internally, loop them in or I can pull together a quick estimate.

Attachments: pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on calendar.

Best,

Alex — thanks. Both windows look possible but Priya is out of office Mon afternoon. Our preferred time is Tue Mar 21 13:00 PT — that lines up with our engineering lead and also lets procurement triage on Tue morning.

A couple of asks from our side before the call:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood has a current SOC 2 report and if we can get the certificate or SOC 2 Type II auditor name ahead of the call?
- Any network/firewall IP ranges we need to pre-approve?
- Procurement will want a short one-pager with expected monthly committed cost range and overage rules (we don’t need a full quote yet, just a range).

I’ve added Jenna (procurement) on cc. Priya — any objections to Tue 1pm PT?

Cheers,
Sam

Thanks Sam — Tue 1pm PT works for Rishi and me. Quick note on the agenda so we can honor everyone’s time:
- 1:00–1:20 PM PT — Discovery (product/ops goals, success criteria, data residency & security constraints)
- 1:20–1:55 PM PT — Demo focused on your latency/cost profile & integration points
- 1:55–2:00 PM PT — Next steps (procurement/PO path, pilot scope)

I agree with Sam that the SOC 2 evidence and firewall ranges are the highest priority for Priya and your security engineer. I’m attaching a short network-firewall-requirements.pdf with the common egress ranges and ports we use for hosted deployments — most customers whitelist these prior to a demo for live agent-in-the-loop testing.

Also, to reduce scheduling friction, would CloudForge prefer we split discovery (30m) and demo (45m) into two adjacent blocks? That makes it easier for Priya to attend only the discovery portion if needed. No problem either way.

Attachments: network-firewall-requirements.pdf

On the SOC 2 question: Redwood’s security team will provide a SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; I can route the request to our security contact and include the auditor name if you confirm the NDA path. I’ll also drop a link to our security intake doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CloudForge-PreDemo

— Rishi

Thanks all — locking Tue Mar 21 13:00–14:00 PT for the combined discovery + demo. Calendar invite has been sent to the list (please accept).

To summarize and next steps before the meeting:
- Triage items for CloudForge: please complete the attached pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf (5–8 fields that help us size the demo) ideally by Mon EOD so Rishi can tailor the demo.
- Security evidence: we can provide SOC 2 Type II under NDA. Sam / Priya — if you prefer, I can send a DocuSign NDA now; otherwise we can surface SOC 2 pieces in the shared Drive folder.
- Procurement: Alex will follow up with a 1-page cost ballpark before the call.
- Network readiness: please review network-firewall-requirements.pdf and confirm if your infra team will whitelist the ranges.

Attachments included: pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf, network-firewall-requirements.pdf
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CloudForge-PreDemo, https://www.docusign.com/CLDF-NDA-1234
